thread:
Nina (AE): quick sync  - MeridianHealth wants EU+APAC residency guarantees for a 6-week POC. Asks: region-scoped subprocessors, proof certs for pinned endpoints, routing policy that never egresses user content, BYOK with HSM option, and a concise delta for a small reserved pool. Can legal/ops help?
Rafael (SE): clarifying  - is global control-plane metadata allowed (auth/routing only) or must control-plane be in-region too?
Maya (Customer): control-plane metadata ok outside region provided no user content, logs, or KV cache leave the pinned region. Failover must not route data through a third region. BYOK preferred; HSM if doable.
Priyanka (Legal): we can provide subprocessors manifest + SOC2/ISO certs. If they insist on in-region control-plane we escalate to Private. I'll flag subprocessors that operate EU/APAC infra.
Evan (Infra): hosted = affinity, not hard lock. Dedicated supports tenant pinning to eu-central-1 and ap-northeast-1 with data-plane + KV kept in-region. BYOK w/ HSM onboarding ~8-12 business days.
Rafael (SE): sample endpoints for their devs:
````
POST https://api.redwood-inference.eu/v1/generate
POST https://api.redwood-inference.ap/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
````
Control plane (global metadata): https://control.redwood-inference.com (no user payload).
Nina (AE): Maya  - procurement wants a headline delta for a small reserved pool (~70 sustained QPS) to assess TCO.
Rafael (SE): ballpark: single-region small reserved (4x A100 equiv) ~ +$11k-14k/mo. Dual-region reserved for strict failover ~ +$18k-23k/mo. Quantization + batching can reduce effective token cost ~20-30%. Will produce a formal quote.
Priyanka (Legal): I'll assemble DPA + subprocessors CSV with region flags and a short addendum for procurement.
Evan (Infra): ops checklist for MeridianHealth to provide:
- Preferred regions to pin (eu-central-1 / ap-northeast-1)
- Sustained QPS + peak burst
- BYOK: public key, KMS contact, rotation policy
- IP ranges for allowlist (optional)
- Certs required (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI if applicable)
- POC start window and rollback plan
ops-bot: maintenance notice - ap-northeast-1 network patch 2025-06-04 02:00-03:00 JST; no data-plane downtime expected.
Maya (Customer): thanks all. Please include a one-pager for BYOK steps/timeline and a subprocessors CSV we can share with procurement.
Nina (AE): will package: Priyanka/Evan please drop subprocessors + BYOK one-pager and Rafael will add the quote. Tagging for deal-room handoff.
